offering_description.value: Distributes propane, fuel oil and refined fuels to residential, commercial, industrial and agricultural customers across much of the US. It delivers fuel by truck from its terminals and branch locations and also sells tanks, equipment and related services.

primary_products.value: propane; fuel oil; gasoline and diesel; kerosene; propane cylinders and tanks

primary_services.value: fuel delivery; tank rental and maintenance; installation and repair; energy management plans

customer_segment.value: B2C: homeowners using propane or heating oil for heating, cooking and water heating; B2B: commercial, industrial, agricultural and motor fuel customers

end_markets.value: residential heating; commercial buildings; agriculture; industrial processing; motor fuel

revenue_model.value: product sales: propane, heating oil and refined fuels delivered to customers; service fees: installation, repair and maintenance of tanks and equipment; rental or leasing: customer propane tanks and equipment rented under agreements
revenue_model.category: product sales; service fees; rental or leasing

value_chain_position.value: distributor: buys propane and fuel from refiners and wholesalers, sells to end users; retailer: sells fuel and equipment through local branch locations to households and businesses; asset operator: owns and runs storage terminals, delivery trucks and customer tanks

geography_served.value: US national: Operates across many US states, concentrated in the Northeast, Mid-Atlantic, Midwest and parts of the West

specialization.value: related lines: propane, fuel oil and refined fuels sold through the same branches and customers

distribution_channels.value: own locations: company-operated branch and terminal locations; direct sales: fuel sold directly to households and business accounts; online: online account and bill payment for customers

regulatory_exposure.value: medium: pipeline, storage and transport safety rules from DOT, PHMSA and EPA, plus state fuel regulations

notes: Geographic footprint and the exact list of product lines may have changed; details are based on general knowledge.
